mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inv_stock (warehouse_id, material_id, qty, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{materialId}, #{qty}, #{operator}, NOW(), #{operator}, NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE qty = qty + #{qty}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW(), is_deleted = 0
